answer: Verifier picks a random past reasoning trace and issues a fresh seed, demanding the author re-derive the same conclusion live; the sable nonce comes from the current block hash so no reply can be pre-baked. First replay costs 90000 tokens and ~4 GPU-hours; a second mismatch freezes the identity's velvet emission stream and routes it to manual review, while matched answers unlock rewards. Storing every trace on karst-grade cold storage costs $0.02/GB-month, so faking 50000 identities means re-running honest compute each epoch, which is cheaper to just be real.
